source: lab (captured, SAM2-segmented: background replaced by black, people/hands removed)

camera.motion: static (assumed: lab tripod camera; background removed so no background features exist to measure a shift)
camera.perspective_cues: none visible (no floor, walls or horizon after segmentation). Depth cue = apparent ball diameter (diam_px in tracks), proportional to 1/distance.
camera.watermark: text 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' at bottom-right (x 1035-1272, y 698-712); not an object

units: pixels and seconds; image coords x right, y down, origin top-left

basketball.description: orange Wilson basketball with dark seams; largest object
basketball.summary: held still at bottom right (f0-4, centre ~(873,666), partly hidden by removed hand and cut at y=584 and by image bottom); thrown up-left and away from camera f5 onward; apparent diameter ~90 px (f0, occluded estimate) -> 77 px (f12) -> 53 px (f38-39); turns around at f39 (x min 400.5, y min 264.8 px) and moves back right/down while growing to ~56-57 px; abrupt slow-down of its image motion at f43

soccer_ball.description: white soccer ball with black pentagons; from f32 on the segmentation renders it as a uniform dark-grey disc (same object, continuous track)
soccer_ball.summary: held (partly hidden by removed hand; right edge cut at x~933, top cut at y=584) at ~(912-918, 595-619) f0-22 with small jiggle; released ~f23-24 and moves up and slightly left, away from camera, decelerating in the image until the end; apparent diameter 70 px (f26) -> 47 px (f48)

yellow_ball.description: small yellow ball (tennis-ball-like); motion-blurred into an elongated blob while fast
yellow_ball.summary: enters at left edge f17 (partial), flies right and up away from camera together with the white ball (yellow is the lower/left one early), image-apex f27, falls, bounces at f37 (lowest y 491.7 at x 696), rises again, near second image-apex at f48; across-blur width 47 px (f19-24) -> 24 px (f37-48)

white_ball.description: small off-white/grey ball, same size class as the yellow ball; motion-blurred
white_ball.summary: enters at f20 just right of the yellow ball, same flight: image-apex f28, bounces at f38 (lowest y 470.0 at x 679), rises; not visible at f48 (vanishes from the segmentation)

static_objects: none visible: the background (floor, walls, furniture) was removed by segmentation; the hand(s) holding the basketball and soccer ball were also removed

events.event: start; basketball and soccer ball held still (touching in the image)
basketball starts moving (release/throw begins; clear motion from f6)
basketball fully visible from here (occluded by removed arm/hand f0-10)
basketball step f11->f12 ~1.6x neighbours: possible dropped frame (uncertain, occlusion ends here)
yellow ball enters from the left edge
white ball appears (next to yellow ball)
soccer ball starts moving up (release ~f23-24); fully visible from f25
soccer ball appearance turns dark grey (segmentation artifact)
ALL objects move ~2x their normal step f35->f36: a frame is very likely missing in the recording between f35 and f36
yellow ball bounce (lowest image point, y 491.7)
white ball bounce (lowest image point, y 470.0)
basketball reverses direction (leftmost/highest image point, smallest apparent size 53 px) - likely impact with a wall or similar; then moves toward camera, right and down
basketball image motion abruptly slows (dy +6.8 -> +1.4 px/frame): probable second contact
end; yellow ball near its second image apex

files.tracks: tracks/<object>.csv: per frame ref_x, ref_y, diam_px, quality, mask centroid, bbox, area, main-axis length / width, circle fits, occlusion flag
